inForce.basis: BC Laws presents this as the current consolidation of an unrepealed enactment; no repeal line appears in the document. The site's separate 'Amendments Not in Force' list was not reachable by the routes tried (see researchNotes); the Point in Time index for B.C. Reg. 190/84 lists no version dated after July 1, 2026.

unresolved: The authority prints 'M.U.s 4.1 to 4-9'. Unit existence (2026-09-23): the authority's WMU service (openmaps.gov.bc.ca WHSE_WILDLIFE_MANAGEMENT.WAA_WILDLIFE_MGMT_UNITS_SVW, WFS GetFeature, sha256 60aace0cb181fc791addb05c23a6b85002022609c29b486bd248136be20f7ca7) returns 225 units, matching B.C. Reg. 64/96 s. 1 ('The Province is divided into 225 management units'). Region 4 has no units 4-10 to 4-13, so '4-1 to 4-9 and 4-14 to 4-40' and Part 1 item 17 name the same existing units. [OFFICIAL_SUMMARY tier, not this regulation:] The 2026–2028 Synopsis prints this window as 's4-1 to 4-9, 4-14 to 4-40 Aug 1 - Aug 31' with the note 'Restricted to private land only, hunter must obtain permission from landowners prior to access.' Recorded as printed; the '4.1' reading is left to the engine owner.
'Despite Part 1' states the provision operates notwithstanding the Part 1 seasons; whether that is ADDS is our reading, so composition is omitted.

LAND TENURE CONDITION: the moderator reports the certified bundle carries age and implement conditions but no land-tenure condition. If this window is encoded without 'on private property', it is a live defect.
